Skybrary makes safety and occurrence data a major missing theme.

Planned scope:

- occurrence reports;
- accident and incident databases;
- taxonomies;
- runway incursions and excursions;
- loss of separation;
- TCAS/ACAS events;
- reporting bias;
- ethical use of safety data.
